mentions.name: RapidCAM
mentions.description: CAM web app for CNC work that already supports 2.5D CNC, laser, and rotary axis toolpaths, and is adding tufting support for CNC tufting makers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding tufting support to RapidCAM.app for CNC run makers.   RapidCAM already supports 2.5D CNC, laser and rotary axis so tufting was a good fit.
mentions.author: Jemm
